name: Setouchi (Okayama, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Setouchi city emblem in blue, green and red: a blue and green stylised swoosh around a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Setouchi, a city in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 2004.

features.role: Setouchi city emblem — a blue and green stylised swoosh around a red disc
